coverage_note: No item could be confirmed as newly published by Meta AI within the ~2026-08-15 to 2026-08-29 window during this run. Meta's major official AI statements this cycle -- Mark Zuckerberg's 'The Future is for Everyone' AI letter (about.fb.com, 2026-08-10), the Muse Code / Muse Spark 1.2 release (ai.meta.com / AI at Meta social, 2026-08-05), and the Muse Glimmer 30B open-weights release (2026-08-10) -- all predate the target window and were excluded per collection scope rather than stretched to fill it. Two Meta Newsroom posts with URLs indicating August 2026 publication were found via search ('Closed-Loop Cooling Explained: The Plumbing Behind Meta's AI' at about.fb.com/news/2026/08/closed-loop-cooling-explained-the-plumbing-behind-metas-ai/, and a Vision Ireland free AI-glasses donation post at about.fb.com/news/2026/08/the-future-is-for-everyone-free-ai-glasses-for-every-blind-and-visually-impaired-adult-vision-ireland-supports/), but this run's WebFetch tool returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for all domains tested (ai.meta.com, about.fb.com, meta.com, x.com, and control domains like wikipedia.org and google.com), and the WebSearch quota was exhausted before a follow-up query could confirm exact publication days. Rather than assert an unverified date, these two candidates are flagged here for manual/next-run verification and were not added to items. A Bloomberg report (2026-08-20) on Meta's Azure spending was also excluded as it is secondary financial journalism, not an official Meta channel, and thus outside this collector's source rules.
